name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate
summary: Skin and eye irritant. Widely used surfactant. Moderate dermal irritant with repeated exposure.

name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate
summary: Flammable solid. Harmful if swallowed. Skin/eye/respiratory irritant. Strong surfactant, common in cleaning products.

name: Fragrance
summary: May cause allergic skin reaction. Undisclosed blend — cannot assess specific hazards without full breakdown.

name: Citric Acid
summary: Eye irritant. Mild acid, naturally occurring. Low overall hazard.

name: Sodium Hydroxide
summary: Corrosive. Severe skin burns and eye damage. Common drain cleaner ingredient.

name: Limonene
summary: Flammable. Skin sensititizer. Aspiration hazard. Aquatic toxicity. Common citrus-scented fragrance component.

name: Ethanol
summary: Highly flammable. Eye irritant. Low toxicity otherwise.

name: Hydrogen Peroxide
summary: Corrosive. Severe eye damage. Aquatic toxicity. Common disinfectant.

name: Quaternary Ammonium Compounds (DDAC)
summary: Harmful if swallowed. Corrosive. Very toxic to aquatic life. Common disinfectant in cleaning products.
